title: game/session.json
description: The session (C07): the objectives in the HUD's order, the closing line's pool, the starting items and the beacon's start. Loaded by ObjectiveBook (Vocaterra.Game.Core).

closingPool.description: The dialogue pool whose first line is said when every objective is done (its NPC's voice: the innkeeper's, Y07).

innBeacon.description: The scene place (a site or a point, by its name) the point-inn completion hook sends the beacon to (Y07: the inn). Required when an objective names that hook.

grants.description: The items the learner starts with, one of each.

wears.description: The items the learner starts wearing, each put on in the first slot that takes it (I08a); each needs a wear slot.

beaconStart.description: The scene site or point the beacon stands on at the start of a new game.
